## Brand & Style

This design system embodies an authoritative, precise, and utilitarian corporate desktop software experience tailored for mission-critical enterprise administration. Rooted in professional efficiency, technical clarity, and high information density, it optimizes workflows for technical leads, enterprise architects, and AI orchestrators.

The aesthetic fuses **Corporate / Modern** desktop engineering with desktop-native application ergonomics:
- **Calm, High-Legibility Visual Hierarchy:** A crisp, light-neutral backdrop keeps complex enterprise registries visually organized without fatigue.
- **Utilitarian Discipline:** Every pixel, boundary, and contrast level reinforces operational confidence, system uptime, and rigorous management of agentic capabilities.
- **Native Shell Ergonomics:** Integrated native window controls, fixed-width navigational infrastructure, and precise state indicators evoke a robust native desktop client.

## Colors

The palette is engineered for prolonged operational focus, leveraging high-contrast functional color assignments with soft, tint-matched structural containers.

### Core Canvas & Structure
- **App Canvas (`#fafafa`):** Primary desktop substrate framing the working environment.
- **Surface Elevation (`#ffffff`):** Work surfaces, active inspectors, modal sheets, and data tables.
- **Sidebar Surface (`#f4f4f5`):** Docked navigation strip providing tactile separation from data panes.
- **Dividers & Structural Borders (`#e1e3e7`):** Precision 1px grid alignments that maintain architectural division without visual heaviness.
- **Deep Ink Primary Text (`#24272b`):** High-clarity typography for maximum readability across complex data sets.
- **Muted Subtext (`#6b6f79`):** Secondary meta-information, property labels, and column headers.

### Functional Status Tokens
- **Accent Primary / Informational:** Text/Icon `#1657b8`, Container Surface `#edf4ff`.
- **Operational Success:** Text/Icon `#087b58`, Container Surface `#e8f6ef`.
- **Warning / Review Required:** Text/Icon `#92580b`, Container Surface `#fff5e4`.
- **Critical / Deprecated:** Text/Icon `#ac3535`, Container Surface `#fff0f0`.

### Agent Multi-Model Identifiers
- **AIPro:** Ink `#1657b8`, Tint `#edf4ff`.
- **Claude:** Ink `#b94b29`, Tint `#faede8` (Warm Terracotta).
- **Gemini:** Ink `#6a3ebd`, Tint `#f3ecff` (Structured Violet).
- **Codex:** Ink `#464a53`, Tint `#eceef1` (Graphite Slate).

## Typography

The typographic hierarchy prioritizes systematic density, legibility, and geometric vertical balance. Rendered with an enterprise system-sans profile (Inter / Segoe UI metric stack), the scale enforces crisp vertical alignment inside compressed row heights and split-pane inspectors.

- **Monospace Integration:** JetBrains Mono is assigned exclusively to runtime parameters, skill IDs, schema versions, and endpoint configurations to avoid character ambiguity.
- **Visual Weighting:** Semantic emphasis relies on transitioning from `400` to `500` or `600` weight rather than arbitrary scale jumps.
- **Scale Compactness:** Headline scale is deliberately constrained (peaking at 20px) to maximize real-estate efficiency within a standard desktop display frame.

## Layout & Spacing

The architectural layout utilizes a structured desktop shell targeting a primary canvas viewport of 1440×900 and scaling dynamically.

### Shell Matrix
- **Window Chrome Titlebar:** 32px fixed height across the entire upper perimeter. Hosts the application brand mark, document caption, global search quick-jump, and platform native window controls (minimize, maximize, close).
- **Navigation Dock (Sidebar):** Fixed width of exactly 225px. Spans the vertical height immediately beneath the titlebar, containing system grouping, skill catalogs, and environmental presets.
- **Main Working Stage:** Dynamic fluid grid split into master inventory panes (flexible `1fr`) and an optional collapsible inspection drawer (fixed 380px).
- **Rhythm & Grid:** Built upon a 4px/8px incremental cadence. Gaps between form controls, table cells, and panel borders honor compact information grouping without edge crowding.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual separation is constructed using **low-contrast structural outlines** alongside subdued, planar tonal changes rather than high-deflection drop shadows.

- **Level 0 (App Base Canvas):** `#fafafa` base surface.
- **Level 1 (Docked Panels & Data Tables):** `#ffffff` with a crisp `1px solid #e1e3e7` border. No drop shadow.
- **Level 2 (Active Dropdowns & Flyout Menus):** `#ffffff` surface, `1px solid #e1e3e7`, accompanied by an ambient boundary blur: `box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(36, 39, 43, 0.08)`.
- **Level 3 (Modal Dialogs & Confirmation Overlays):** `#ffffff` surface with `box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(36, 39, 43, 0.16)`. Overlays render over a darkened backdrop wash (`rgba(36, 39, 43, 0.35)`).

## Shapes

The design system employs a **Soft** geometric shape posture (`roundedness: 1`), projecting an engineered, institutional presence.

- **Panels, Windows, & Cards:** 4px border radius (`0.25rem`). This provides slight corner smoothing while retaining strong rectangular structure along screen divisions.
- **Form Fields & Standard Buttons:** 4px border radius (`0.25rem`).
- **Status Badges & Model Indicators:** 3px border radius for compact rectangular tags, or fully round (circle) for pure dot telemetry.
- **Modal Containers:** 6px border radius (`0.375rem`) to signify independent layering above the root desktop frame.

## Components

### Titlebar & Window Chrome
- **Container:** 32px height, background `#f4f4f5`, border-bottom `1px solid #e1e3e7`.
- **Window Controls (Right):** Horizontal button trio (Minimize, Maximize, Close) with 44px width each. Close button shifts background to `#ac3535` with white iconography on hover; minimize/maximize shifts to `#e1e3e7`.
- **Title Caption:** Center-aligned or left-docked with 12px Medium type in `#24272b`, coupled with a subtle lockup icon.

### Buttons & Actions
- **Primary:** Background `#1657b8`, foreground `#ffffff`, height 28px or 32px, horizontal padding 12px, border-radius 4px. Hover: `#124491`.
- **Secondary / Neutral:** Background `#ffffff`, border `1px solid #e1e3e7`, foreground `#24272b`. Hover: background `#f4f4f5`, border `#d2d5dc`.
- **Destructive:** Background `#fff0f0`, border `1px solid #ac3535`, foreground `#ac3535`. Hover: background `#ac3535`, foreground `#ffffff`.

### Badges, Chips & Agent Indicators
- **State Badges:** Padding 2px 6px, font-size 11px, font-weight 500, line-height 14px, radius 3px.
  - Active: `#087b58` on `#e8f6ef`.
  - Staging/Paused: `#92580b` on `#fff5e4`.
  - Error/Revoked: `#ac3535` on `#fff0f0`.
- **Agent Provider Indicator:** A dual-element capsule. Displays a 6px solid dot indicator beside the provider label:
  - *AIPro:* Dot `#1657b8`, background `#edf4ff`, text `#1657b8`.
  - *Claude:* Dot `#b94b29`, background `#faede8`, text `#b94b29`.
  - *Gemini:* Dot `#6a3ebd`, background `#f3ecff`, text `#6a3ebd`.
  - *Codex:* Dot `#464a53`, background `#eceef1`, text `#464a53`.

### Data Tables & Property Sheets
- **Header Cells:** Background `#f4f4f5`, height 28px, text color `#6b6f79`, font size 11px, font weight 600, uppercase letter-spacing 0.04em, bottom border `1px solid #e1e3e7`.
- **Data Rows:** Background `#ffffff`, alternating with `#fafafa` on high-density grids. Height 32px, text color `#24272b`, font size 13px, bottom border `1px solid #e1e3e7`. Row hover state: `#edf4ff`.
- **Selected Row:** Background `#edf4ff`, left edge visual anchor `2px solid #1657b8`.

### Input Fields & Select Controls
- **Geometry:** Height 28px (compact) or 32px (standard), 8px horizontal padding, radius 4px.
- **States:** Border `1px solid #e1e3e7`, background `#ffffff`, text `#24272b`. Focus creates an immediate highlight with border `1px solid #1657b8` and a 1px soft focus ring (`rgba(22, 87, 184, 0.2)`).

### Modal Dialogs
- **Framing:** Centered, width 480px to 640px, background `#ffffff`, border `1px solid #e1e3e7`, radius 6px, level 3 elevation.
- **Structure:** 44px modal header with bottom border, padded body area (padding 16px), 48px utility footer with top divider `#e1e3e7` and right-aligned action pairs.
